sources.snippet: rekody-streaming-en-.6b-int8 An int8 ONNX conversion of NVIDIA's Nemotron speech streaming 0.6B model (the March 2026 checkpoint), packaged for on-device streaming dictation. This is the model behind Rekody, the private, local-first voice dictation tool for macOS.

sources.title: GitHub - rekody/rekody: An open-source, privacy-first voice dictation ...
sources.snippet: A skill reshapes your dictation via the LLM into a specific form — a professional email, bulleted notes, a commit message, a spec, and more. Skills are Markdown files in ~/.config/rekody/skills/; rekody ships a starter pack and you can add your own.

sources.title: nemotron-asr-streaming Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3 ASR is a 600-million-parameter streaming Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model engineered for high-quality English transcription across both low-latency streaming and high-throughput batch workloads. Developed by NVIDIA, it natively outputs punctuation and capitalization with no post-processing required.
